study: APT investigation identity and evidence selection headroom screen
sampling: Ascending SHA256(salt + pipe + stratum + pipe + source_event_ref), then source_event_ref

cohorts.name: natural_parent
cohorts.population: All valid Sysmon process creations with nonzero parent GUID

cohorts.name: natural_network
cohorts.population: All valid Sysmon network events with nonzero owning process GUID

cohorts.name: ambiguous_parent
cohorts.population: Parent anchors whose same-host parent basename matches at least two distinct recorded creation GUIDs, excluding natural_parent anchors

question: Return the recorded creation event for the parent/owning process: its image, UTC creation time and exact source reference. If absent or conflicting in this capture, report insufficient evidence or ambiguity.
gold: Independent source-table scan by host and normalized target GUID; equivalent records allow multiple acceptable references, conflicting metadata requires ambiguity. Never infer creation time from event collection time.
anchors: Methods receive the unmodified normalized source anchor including GUIDs; identifiers are never synthetically removed from mandatory baselines.
evidence_accounting: Count anchor plus unique returned creation events. Explicit absence/conflict is an index result, with lookup work reported separately. Charge compact aliases and their maps in serialized bytes.
primary_endpoint: Incorrect or unsupported identity answers among answered questions, with correct supported recovery and answered coverage reported separately
decision: NO_GO_NO_HEADROOM if either strong baseline recovers every available creation answer with zero unsupported answers and correct abstention on every unavailable/conflicting case. Stop before an LLM/new selector experiment. Otherwise diagnose the natural remaining error before freezing a separate Stage B protocol.
future_stage_b_gate: Only after natural headroom: primary >=30% relative reduction in wrong links at matched answered coverage and <=2 percentage-point reduction in correct recovery versus strongest comparator. Evidence-cost reduction is secondary and cannot rescue a failed primary endpoint.
limitations: One exposed APT29 emulation day, not independent campaigns or a blind confirmation set.
Direct recorded-identity retrieval is intentionally a cheap screen; exact joins are expected to be strong.
Twenty difficult cases are deliberately enriched; pooled error rate is not population prevalence.
No model efficacy, malicious intent, APT actor attribution or human time saving is measured.
No invented missing data, renamings, attack labels, clock corrections or synthetic attacks.
No label-based case selection or retuning; related process families remain dependent observations.
